content/docs/sem3/csi247/time-complexity: --- title: Algorithm Analysis & Big-O description: Visual study map and comprehensive guide to asymptotic analysis, amortized complexity, and computational theory. --- # Algorithm Analysis & Big-O Last Updated: July 9, 2026 This comprehensive visual map covers the entire Algorithm Analysis module, including: - **Asymptotic Notation:** Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, and Little-o bounds. - **Amortized Analysis:** Aggregate, Accounting, and Potential methods for dynamic arrays. - **Recurrence Relations:** Solving recursive time complexities using the Master Theorem and recursion trees. - **Space Complexity:** Auxiliary space vs. total space, and call stack memory analysis.
content/docs/sem3/csi247/linked-lists-tr: --- title: Linked Lists & Traversals description: Visual study map and comprehensive guide to pointer manipulation and linear traversals. --- # Linked Lists & Traversals Last Updated: July 9, 2026 This comprehensive visual map covers the entire Linked Lists module, including: - **List Variants:** Singly, Doubly, and Circular linked lists, plus Sentinel/Dummy nodes. - **Pointer Manipulation:** Reversal, cycle detection (Floyd's), and finding intersections. - **Linear Traversals:** Fast/Slow pointer techniques, sliding windows, and monotonic lists. - **Memory & Complexity:** Space overhead, cache locality, and $O(1)$ vs $O(N)$ operations.
content/docs/sem3/csi247/stacks-and-queu: --- title: Stacks & Queues description: Visual study map and comprehensive guide to LIFO/FIFO, circular buffers, and monotonic deques. --- # Stacks & Queues Last Updated: July 9, 2026 This comprehensive visual map covers the entire Stacks & Queues module, including: - **Core Paradigms:** LIFO (Stack) vs. FIFO (Queue) operations and array vs. linked implementations. - **Advanced Structures:** Circular queues, Priority Queues (Heaps), and Monotonic Stacks/Deques. - **Applications:** Infix to Postfix conversion (Shunting Yard), BFS/DFS, and sliding window maximums. - **Complexity Analysis:** Amortized $O(1)$ pushes and dynamic resizing overhead.
content/docs/sem3/csi247/sorting-and-sea: --- title: Sorting & Searching description: Visual study map and comprehensive guide to divide-and-conquer, classic sorting, and searching algorithms. --- # Sorting & Searching Last Updated: July 9, 2026 This comprehensive visual map covers the entire Sorting & Searching module, including: - **Comparison Sorts:** Quick Sort (partitioning, pivots), Merge Sort, and Heap Sort. - **Non-Comparison Sorts:** Counting Sort, Radix Sort, and their linear time complexities. - **Searching Algorithms:** Binary search, rotated array search, and interpolation search. - **Algorithm Properties:** Stability, in-place memory constraints, and lower bound proofs ($\Omega(N \log N)$).
content/docs/sem3/csi247/trees-and-bsts/: --- title: Trees & Binary Search Trees description: Visual study map and comprehensive guide to Trees, BSTs, AVL, and Tries. --- # Trees & Binary Search Trees Last Updated: July 9, 2026 This comprehensive visual map covers the entire Trees & BSTs module, including: - **Binary Search Trees:** Insertion, deletion, and $O(H)$ search complexities. - **Tree Traversals:** In-order, pre-order, post-order, and level-order (BFS). - **Self-Balancing Trees:** AVL rotations (LL, RR, LR, RL) and Red-Black tree properties. - **Advanced Structures:** Tries (Prefix Trees) for autocomplete, and Heaps/Priority Queues.
